name: Change OpenBCI GUI Layout to Show Four Widgets
description:
The OpenBCI GUI is running an active Synthetic EEG session. The current layout shows multiple widget panels (Time Series, FFT, and Accelerometer). Your task is to change the layout to display four widget panels simultaneously.

Steps:
1. Look for a 'Layout' dropdown or selector in the top toolbar of the GUI interface (typically near the right side of the top bar).
2. Click the Layout dropdown/button to see the available layout options.
3. The layouts are presented as visual grid diagrams showing how panels will be arranged.
4. Select the layout that shows 4 panels. Look for a 2×2 grid icon (two rows of two equal panels). This is one of the options near the middle of the layout selector grid.
5. After selecting, the GUI should rearrange to show 4 widget panels.

After completing this task, the OpenBCI GUI should show four separate widget panels visible simultaneously on screen. Each panel can be independently configured to show different data visualizations (Time Series, FFT, Band Power, etc.).
